usdRate.sourceName: Bank Indonesia Board of Governors press release, 21 October 2026
usdRate.note: Rupiah at Rp 17,985 per US dollar on 20 October 2026.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Bank Indonesia Board of Governors press release (BPS CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: CPI 3.28% year on year in September 2026 (core 2.84%), per BPS release of 1 October 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank Indonesia inflation target 2.5% plus or minus 1% (2026-2027); 2021-2025 CPI average about 2.7%
inflation_projection.note: Target midpoint is 2.5%, but the 5-year average and the weak rupiah argue for planning slightly above it at 3%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank Indonesia Board of Governors press release, 21 October 2026
policy_rate.note: BI-Rate held at 5.75%; deposit facility raised to 5.00%, lending facility 6.50%.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Industry.co.id survey of large-bank savings rates
savings_account_rate.note: Regular savings accounts at large state and private banks pay about 0.5-1% a year, most at 0.5%; interest is taxed 20% at source.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Fortune Indonesia survey of the four largest banks' deposit rates
fdr_3m_rate.note: 3-month rupiah deposit: 2.25-3.00% across the four largest banks (mean about 2.6%), 27 October 2026. Deposits paying more than the LPS guarantee rate (3.75%) are not guaranteed.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Fortune Indonesia survey of the four largest banks' deposit rates
fdr_1y_rate.note: 12-month rupiah deposit: 2.50-3.00% across the four largest banks (mean about 2.6%), 27 October 2026. Deposits paying more than the LPS guarantee rate (3.75%) are not guaranteed.

dps_rate.note: Banks sell monthly time-savings plans (tabungan berjangka), but no typical published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: OJK, weighted average rupiah third-party funds rate (via Infobank)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: OJK weighted average across current, savings and time deposits, reported 8 May 2026 (Infobank). World Bank FR.INR.DPST (time deposits) was 5.41% for 2025.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Kontan: Government issues ORI029 retail bond
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: ORI029 retail government bond: 3-year 5.45%, 6-year 5.80% fixed; Rp 1 million minimum. The July 2026 ORI030 reportedly paid about 6.9-7.0% (not confirmed from the official notice).

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Indonesia 3-month bill yield (secondary source)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Primary DJPPR auction results were not reachable.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Indonesia 5-year government bond yield (secondary source)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Secondary source; Trading Economics showed 7.71% on 2 November 2026 after a 0.19-point rise, consistent with about 7.52% on 30 October.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Indonesia 10-year government bond yield (secondary source)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Secondary source; previous close 7.64% (30 October 2026), 7.71% on 2 November.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Indonesia individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Final income tax of 20% on interest from savings and time deposits.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Indonesia individual income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on bonds, including retail government bonds (ORI/SR), is subject to 10% final income tax withheld by the payer.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Under the LPS Law, deposits up to Rp 2 billion per depositor per bank are guaranteed, provided the rate paid does not exceed the LPS guarantee rate (3.75% for rupiah deposits at commercial banks, 1 October 2026 to 31 January 2027).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: A Bank Indonesia cap of 1.75% a month (about 21% a year) since July 2021 is widely reported, but the only page read was a company page, which this dataset does not cite; the Bank Indonesia page could not be found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Retail government bond ORI029 5.8% less 10% tax (5.2%); IDX record
equity_return_low.note: Low case reflecting the IDX Composite's weak decade in local currency.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Retail government bond ORI029 5.8% less 10% tax (5.2%); IDX record
equity_return_base.note: After-tax safe rate of about 5.2% plus a 3.3-point premium, kept modest because the main index's 10-year record is weak.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Retail government bond ORI029 5.8% less 10% tax (5.2%); IDX record
equity_return_high.note: High case close to nominal GDP growth plus dividends.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (rupiah per USD, 2025 average 16,478; 17,985 on 20 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with modest rupiah weakening.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (rupiah per USD, 2025 average 16,478; 17,985 on 20 Oct 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus about 3% a year of rupiah depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (rupiah per USD, 2025 average 16,478; 17,985 on 20 Oct 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and faster rupiah depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits only, after the 20% final tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Mix of deposits and retail government bonds after tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: about two thirds retail government bonds (5.2% after tax) and one third deposits (2.1%).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in current government bond yields after the 10% final tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: OJK insurance statistics were not reachable and no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in Indonesia, but no published per-1,000-rupiah premium rates by age were found within this research pass.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health premium table by age was found; most people are covered by JKN (BPJS Kesehatan).

oop_health_share.note: Figure is for 2023 (older than 2025); latest World Bank value.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BPS CPI; Bank Indonesia inflation target 2.5% plus or minus 1%
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI figure was retrieved; we plan with headline plus 1.5 points for private hospital and drug costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BPS CPI; Bank Indonesia inflation target 2.5% plus or minus 1%
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI figure was retrieved; we plan with headline plus 1 point for private school fees.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 71.6 for 2026. World Bank figure is for 2024 (older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there). Values are the UN WPP 2024 estimates for calendar 2026 (mid-year date used).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 11.06 (2025, World Bank), 18.0 (2040) and 28.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/indonesia/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Wikipedia: Retirement age (Indonesia), citing Government Regulation 45/2015 Article 15 (secondary source)
retirement_age_default.note: Jaminan Pensiun age was 56 at the start, 57 from 2019, then rises one year every three years to 65 in 2043 (59 in 2025-2027). Someone born after 1975 reaches pension age in 2040 or later, so 65 applies (64 for people born 1976-1978); same for men and women. The official regulation page (peraturan.bpk.go.id) returned 403.

retirement_age_government.note: Civil servant (ASN) retirement ages could not be confirmed from a reachable official or secondary page in this pass.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposits only after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 3-month government bill 6.55% less 10% tax (5.9%); retail bonds 5.2% after tax
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the after-tax government bill rate, for a mix of retail government bonds and deposits.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Retail government bonds and bills after tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case mostly in government bills and retail bonds after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Retail government bond ORI029 5.8% less 10% tax (5.2%); IDX record
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if equities match bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Retail government bond ORI029 5.8% less 10% tax (5.2%); IDX record
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half equity at 8.5% and half fixed income at 5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Retail government bond ORI029 5.8% less 10% tax (5.2%); IDX record
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with the equity high case.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Indonesia has no universal non-contributory old-age pension; poor elderly receive means-tested household aid (PKH elderly component, ATENSI), but current amounts could not be confirmed from a reachable source.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No universal social pension; eligibility rules for the PKH elderly component could not be confirmed from a reachable source.

gratuity_rule.note: Severance (pesangon) on retirement exists under Government Regulation 35/2021 (months of wages by years of service plus a long-service award), but no reachable source was read in this pass and the capped formula does not map cleanly to days per year.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, Jaminan Pensiun for wage earners
public_pension_scheme.note: Jaminan Pensiun (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan): 2% employer plus 1% employee on wages up to Rp 10,547,400; monthly pension Rp 411,400 to 4,932,300 in 2026 (limits raised yearly, hence inflationLinked). Pension age is 59 in 2025-2027 and rises to 65 by 2043 (Government Regulation 45/2015), so 65 is used for people born after 1975. Separate JHT savings: 3.7% employer plus 2% employee.

dps.note: Fixed monthly deposits for a set term; offered by most banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold online several times a year from Rp 1 million; ORI is tradable, SR is sharia-compliant; coupon tax 10%.

tbill_91d.note: Sold at auction; retail investors buy through brokers or bank secondary markets.

equity_fund.localName: Reksa dana saham / reksa dana indeks
equity_fund.note: Regulated by OJK; widely sold online from small amounts.

gold.note: Gold bars and coins are freely bought; also sold in small gram amounts through gold savings accounts.

pensionScheme.name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (Jaminan Pensiun and Jaminan Hari Tua)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Kementerian Sosial (elderly social assistance)
oldAgeAllowance.note: No universal social pension; means-tested aid only.
